systemContext.description: An integrated healthcare management platform connecting doctors, diagnostic laboratories, patients, and administrators through a unified digital ecosystem.

faqs.question: What is Swasthify?
faqs.answer: Swasthify is an end-to-end healthcare management platform designed to streamline interactions between doctors, diagnostic laboratories, and patients. It enables appointment scheduling, campaign management, profile verification, and centralized administrative control.

faqs.question: Who can use the Swasthify platform?
faqs.answer: Swasthify supports three primary user roles: Doctors, who provide medical consultations and services; Diagnostic Lab Partners, who offer testing and diagnostic services; and Super Admins, who manage and oversee platform operations.

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
faqs.answer: To reset your password, select the 'Forgot Password' option on the login page. Enter your registered email address to receive a secure password reset link and follow the instructions provided.

faqs.question: How do I update my profile information?
faqs.answer: You can update your profile by navigating to the Profile section from the main menu. Select 'Edit Profile', make the necessary changes, and save to apply updates.

faqs.question: How do I create a doctor profile?
faqs.answer: To register and create your doctor profile, please visit /auth/doctor.

faqs.question: How do I access the Doctor Panel?
faqs.answer: Once logged in using your doctor credentials, you will be automatically redirected to the Doctor Panel. Alternatively, you may access it via the '/doctor-panel' route.

faqs.question: How do I complete my doctor profile?
faqs.answer: Within the Doctor Panel, navigate to the Profile section and complete all mandatory fields, including specialization, qualifications, experience, registration number, and supporting documents. A completed profile is mandatory for verification.

faqs.question: How can I create a campaign?
faqs.answer: To create a campaign, go to the Campaigns section and select 'Create New Campaign'. Configure campaign details such as service type, pricing, availability schedule, location, appointment limits, and required patient information before submitting.

faqs.question: Which documents are required for verification?
faqs.answer: Doctors must upload a valid medical registration certificate, government-issued ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, or Passport), and an optional professional profile photograph.

faqs.question: What types of campaigns can doctors create?
faqs.answer: Doctors can create campaigns for General Consultations, Specialist Consultations, Preventive Health Checkups, Follow-up Visits, and Customized Care Programs.

faqs.question: How are appointment limits configured?
faqs.answer: During campaign setup, doctors can define daily appointment limits, hourly capacity, and total campaign capacity to efficiently manage schedules.

faqs.question: Can campaigns be edited or deleted?
faqs.answer: Campaign details can be edited or paused at any time. Campaigns with active appointments cannot be deleted to protect existing bookings.

faqs.question: How do I manage appointments?
faqs.answer: The Appointments section allows doctors to view, filter, reschedule, cancel, or mark appointments as completed based on their status.

faqs.question: What is the doctor verification process?
faqs.answer: After profile completion and document submission, verification is performed by a Super Admin. Campaign creation is enabled only after successful verification.

faqs.question: How do I create a lab profile?
faqs.answer: To register and create your lab profile, please visit /auth/lab.

faqs.question: How do I access the Lab Panel?
faqs.answer: Lab users are redirected to the Lab Panel upon successful login. The panel can also be accessed via the '/lab-panel' route.

faqs.question: How do I complete my lab profile?
faqs.answer: Lab partners must complete their profile by providing registration details, available test categories, infrastructure information, contact details, and mandatory verification documents.

faqs.question: What diagnostic services can be offered?
faqs.answer: Labs may offer services such as Pathology, Radiology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Blood Tests, Urine Tests, and specialized diagnostics based on their capabilities.

faqs.question: Which documents are required for lab verification?
faqs.answer: Labs must submit a valid registration certificate, owner identification proof, address proof, and an optional lab profile image for verification.

faqs.question: How do I create a lab campaign?
faqs.answer: Lab campaigns can be created from the Campaigns section by configuring test details, pricing, sample collection options, schedules, and capacity limits.

faqs.question: Can labs provide home sample collection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Labs can enable home sample collection, specify serviceable areas, and configure additional charges during campaign creation.

faqs.question: How are lab bookings managed?
faqs.answer: The Bookings section allows labs to manage appointments, update booking statuses, schedule sample collections, and upload test reports.

faqs.question: What is the lab verification process?
faqs.answer: Lab verification is conducted by the Super Admin after reviewing registration details, licenses, and facilities. Verified labs can activate campaigns and accept bookings.

faqs.question: What responsibilities does a Super Admin have?
faqs.answer: Super Admins oversee the entire platform, including user verification, permissions management, analytics monitoring, campaign oversight, and compliance enforcement.

faqs.question: How are doctor profiles verified?
faqs.answer: Doctor verification is managed through the User Management module, where submitted documents and credentials are reviewed before approval.

faqs.question: How are lab profiles verified?
faqs.answer: Super Admins review lab registration details, licenses, and facilities through the Lab Management interface before granting approval.

faqs.question: How are user permissions managed?
faqs.answer: Admins can configure user permissions such as campaign creation, booking access, and profile visibility from the User Management section.

faqs.question: Where can platform analytics be viewed?
faqs.answer: The Admin Dashboard provides insights into user growth, campaigns, bookings, and revenue metrics with exportable reports.

faqs.question: Can Super Admins edit user details?
faqs.answer: Yes. Admins may edit user information while maintaining audit logs for compliance and transparency.

faqs.question: How are user complaints handled?
faqs.answer: Complaints and support requests can be managed through the Support module, enabling responses, escalations, and enforcement actions.

faqs.question: I am unable to log in. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Verify your login credentials, reset your password if required, and clear browser cache. If the issue persists, contact support.

faqs.question: Document upload is failing.
faqs.answer: Ensure files are in supported formats (PDF, JPG, PNG) and under the size limit. Try again using a stable internet connection.

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: To book an appointment, browse for a doctor or clinic, select your preferred time slot, and confirm the booking. You'll receive a confirmation notification once it's done.

faqs.question: Can I reschedule my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your appointment from the 'My Appointments' section by selecting the reschedule option and picking a new time slot.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can cancel your appointment through the 'My Appointments' tab. Please check our cancellation policy for any applicable time limits.

faqs.question: Will I get a reminder before my appointment?
faqs.answer: Yes, Swasthify sends automated reminders via app notifications and an AI reminder call to ensure you don't miss your appointment.

faqs.question: What time should I leave for my appointment?
faqs.answer: The Swasthify AI calculates your travel time based on live traffic and will call you at the optimal time to leave.

faqs.question: What happens if my appointment is delayed?
faqs.answer: If there's a delay, we'll notify you via the app so you can adjust your travel plans accordingly.

faqs.question: What is the Swasthify AI reminder call?
faqs.answer: It's an intelligent voice call that reminds you of your appointment and suggests when to leave based on current traffic conditions.

faqs.question: How does the AI decide when I should leave?
faqs.answer: Our AI analyzes real-time traffic data, your distance from the clinic, and common travel speeds to determine the best departure time.

faqs.question: Will the AI really check live traffic?
faqs.answer: Yes, Swasthify integrates with live traffic services to provide accurate travel time estimates and departure alerts.

faqs.question: What if I miss the AI call?
faqs.answer: Don't worry! You'll still receive app notifications, and you can view the appointment details and departure suggestions anytime in the app.

faqs.question: Will I receive a map or navigation link?
faqs.answer: Yes, every appointment confirmation includes a navigation link to guide you to the clinic using your preferred map service.

faqs.question: Can I turn off AI reminder calls?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can manage your communication preferences in the 'Settings' section of the app to disable or enable reminder calls.

faqs.question: How many reminder calls will I get?
faqs.answer: Typically, you'll receive one AI call when it's time to leave for your appointment.

faqs.question: Will the AI speak in my language?
faqs.answer: Swasthify AI is being updated to support multiple regional languages. Check 'Settings' for current language options.

faqs.question: Does Swasthify track my live location?
faqs.answer: We only use your location to calculate travel time for your booked appointments. Your privacy is protected and location data is not shared.

faqs.question: Can I change my location manually?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you're starting from a different location than usual, you can update your starting point for travel calculations in the appointment details.

faqs.question: Which map service does Swasthify use?
faqs.answer: Swasthify integrates with popular map services like Google Maps to provide navigation and traffic data.

faqs.question: What happens if traffic suddenly changes?
faqs.answer: The AI monitors traffic continuously leading up to your departure time and will adjust your 'time to leave' alert accordingly.

faqs.question: What if I am already near the clinic?
faqs.answer: The AI will recognize your proximity and may skip the departure call, but you'll still receive the standard appointment reminder.

faqs.question: What if my phone is switched off?
faqs.answer: If your phone is off, you'll miss the call and notifications. We recommend keeping your device on to receive real-time alerts.

faqs.question: Are doctors on Swasthify verified?
faqs.answer: Yes, every doctor on Swasthify undergoes a strict verification process where we check their medical registrations and credentials.

faqs.question: Can I see doctor ratings and reviews?
faqs.answer: Yes, we encourage patients to leave feedback. You can see ratings and reviews on each doctor's profile page.

faqs.question: Can I search doctors by specialization?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can use our search filters to find doctors by their specialization, city, or symptoms.

faqs.question: Is doctor availability shown in real time?
faqs.answer: Yes, the time slots you see reflect the doctor's current real-time availability.

faqs.question: Is Swasthify free to use?
faqs.answer: Downloading and browsing Swasthify is free. You only pay for the consultations and diagnostic services you book.

faqs.question: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.answer: While you can browse some services, you'll need an account to book appointments and securely store your medical records.

faqs.question: Can I use Swasthify without downloading the app?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can access Swasthify services through our web portal on any desktop or mobile browser.

faqs.question: Who can use Swasthify?
faqs.answer: Swasthify is designed for anyone seeking healthcare services, as well as doctors and laboratories looking to manage their practice.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept various payment methods including UPI, Credit/Debit cards, and Net Banking for online bookings.

faqs.question: Is online payment safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, Swasthify uses secure, industry-standard payment gateways to ensure your transactions and financial data are safe.

faqs.question: Will I receive a payment receipt?
faqs.answer: Yes, a digital receipt will be generated and available in your 'Transactions' history immediately after a successful payment.

faqs.question: Can I pay at the clinic directly?
faqs.answer: Payment options depend on the doctor or clinic. Some services allow 'Pay at Clinic', which you can select during booking.

faqs.question: Can I upload my medical reports?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upload and securely store your lab reports, prescriptions, and images in the 'Records' section of the app.

faqs.question: Can I access my previous prescriptions?
faqs.answer: Yes, all your digital prescriptions issues through Swasthify and those you upload are saved in your electronic health record (EHR).

faqs.question: Can doctors see my uploaded reports?
faqs.answer: Doctors can only see the reports you choose to share with them during your consultation to maintain your privacy.

faqs.question: Does Swasthify reduce waiting time at clinics?
faqs.answer: By booking specific time slots and using arrival alerts, Swasthify helps clinics manage flow, potentially reducing your overall waiting time.

faqs.question: Will clinic staff know when I am arriving?
faqs.answer: Yes, clinics receive alerts about your progress and estimated arrival time based on the platform's tracking.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: You can contact support via the 'Help Center' in the app, through email, or by using our support chatbot.

faqs.question: Can I talk to a human support agent?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the AI cannot resolve your issue, you can request to be connected to a human support representative.

faqs.question: Is my personal data safe?
faqs.answer: We take data security very seriously. Your personal and medical data is encrypted and stored in compliance with healthcare data regulations.

faqs.question: Will my data be shared with anyone?
faqs.answer: Your medical data is shared only with the healthcare providers you consult with. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

faqs.question: Will I receive spam calls from Swasthify?
faqs.answer: No, you will only receive calls related to your appointments or important account security alerts.

faqs.question: Is Swasthify meant for emergencies?
faqs.answer: Swasthify is for scheduled consultations and diagnostic services. For medical emergencies, please immediately contact your local emergency services (like 102 or 108).

faqs.question: Can I give feedback about my experience?
faqs.answer: Yes, we value your feedback! You can rate and review your experience with doctors and the app after each consultation.

faqs.question: Where is Swasthify currently available?
faqs.answer: Swasthify is currently expanding and available in several cities across Bihar. Check the app for specific clinic locations near you.
